title: Three new L'Oréal NY marketing roles + still-open LA favorites
intro: Oct 13's routine didn't publish, so this covers anything new since Oct 12. Three New York L'Oréal openings posted Oct 12–13 (all verified live on careers.loreal.com this morning). All three are stretches. Your strongest LA leads (#20 NYX Brand Partnerships and #3 Youth To The People) are still open. None of today's new postings mentions travel to Paris.

sections.title: New today
sections.intro: Found / verified Oct 14 (posted Oct 12–13). All New York hybrid; Kiehl's product marketing is the clearest brand + partnerships fit of the three.

sections.title: Still open (favorites)
sections.intro: Spot-checked live this morning. #20 and #3 still on careers.loreal.com; Erborian Trade Marketing (#10) still on L'Occitane's board.

notes: SMCP Group: still no US marketing/brand/partnerships — Greenhouse is NY corporate (AR, Allocation Planner, EA) + retail only.
Pernod Ricard Manager, Senior Field Marketing (Los Angeles) still live but 7+ years / ~$140–174k — too senior to number.
Sézane Retail Marketing Associate Manager (LA) appears on aggregators as closed / no longer accepting applications.
Interparfums Senior Trade Marketing Manager, North America appears on aggregators only — not confirmed on the company careers page.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Marketing (Anti-Aging) Kiehl's US
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Kiehl's Since 1851 is in the Luxe division.
jobs.why: Product-category ownership (acne & oily skin franchise) plus go-to-market for launches and hallmark moments — and the posting explicitly asks you to secure smaller-scale brand partnerships. Closest of today's new roles to brand + partnerships work. New York hybrid, not LA.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–7 years of experience — a reach from AE + college marketing internships, but the lower end of the range is more approachable than the other two new roles.

jobs.title: Manager, Advocacy & Influence — Redken US
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Redken is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically, up to 25% — posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: You'd build Redken's professional advocacy and influencer strategy — recruiting creators, running mailer activations, and partnering with Marketing/PR. Partnerships-flavored, but focused on pro/influencer communities rather than brand collabs.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 4–6 years in strategic marketing, brand management, or product management, plus creator-relationship experience.
jobs.title_note: Careers site slug/title says "Incer Pro"; role body is Advocacy & Influence / influencer.

jobs.title: Manager, Brand Marketing — Mizani & L'Oréal Technique US
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Mizani and L'Oréal Technique are in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically (15%) — posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: Full US brand-marketing ownership for two professional hair brands: go-to-market, SalonCentric channel strategy, forecasting, and P&L. Real brand seat — heavier than an assistant-manager role.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 5+ years marketing (prestige beauty/CPG preferred) plus strong forecasting and P&L experience — a clear stretch.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Global Brand Partnerships (NYX Professional Makeup)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); NYX's global brand partnerships team.
jobs.why: Still the strongest LA fit: partnerships with fandoms and communities, no minimum years listed.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Global Marketing (Youth to the People)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Youth To The People global marketing.
jobs.why: Still open — the role you already asked for a tailored resume for.

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Associate Manager, Erborian
jobs.work_arrangement: About 2 days a week in the office
jobs.french_tie: Part of L'Occitane Group, the Provence-born beauty group.
jobs.why: Still live on L'Occitane's applytojob board — Ulta-facing trade marketing.
